claims.claim: EnsureStreams in centralized-data-service/pkgs/natsconn/nats_client.go iterates over all 4 desired stream configs and collects per-stream errors via errors.Join(errs...) so a failure on CDC_EVENTS does not abort creating SCHEMA_DRIFT, SCHEMA_CONFIG, and CDC_TRANSMUTE.

ReconnectHandler in centralized-data-service/pkgs/natsconn/nats_client.go uses client.reconciling.CompareAndSwap(false, true) and spawns a background goroutine to call client.EnsureStreams(subs) upon reconnect.

watchdogLoop in transmute_consumer_pool.go releases p.mu.Unlock() before calling js.ConsumerInfo with a 2-second MaxWait, and ensureSubscribedLocked calls unsubscribeSubsLocked() and ensureStreamExistsLocked() before creating new subscriptions.

publishTransmuteTrigger in batch_buffer_fanout.go breaks out of the JetStream publish retry loop when pubErr matches ErrNoStreamResponse, ErrNoResponders, or ErrStreamNotFound and then publishes fallbackMsg to cdc.cmd.transmute-shadow.core-fallback.

GetOverview in cdc-cms-service/internal/api/system/nats_monitor_handler.go calls tryAutoHealMissingCoreStreams with a 30-second cooldown and refreshes jsz and connz when missing core streams are healed.
